name: Dolmen
author: Erin Carter
description: A single raymarched trilithon - two thick uprights bearing a tilted capstone - eclipses a broad setting glow on the horizon, with recumbent stones layered behind it and ground fog drifting at shin height. The camera traces a very slow wide orbit so the bright portal gap opens, narrows to a sliver as an upright eclipses the light, and opens again, a minutes-long eclipse cycle written purely by parallax.

params.label: Orbit speed
params.effect: How fast the camera arcs around the dolmen, setting the rhythm of the portal eclipse.

params.label: Moon glow
params.effect: Intensity of the warm setting light behind the stones.

params.label: Fog density
params.effect: Thickness of the shin-height mist drifting across the barrow.
